summary: Red team of the accepted library audit AUDIT-04 (five Tau Ceti roadmaps: GlobalNumberFields, GlobalQuadraticForms, LocalFieldsRamification, Multiquadratic, NumberFieldArithmetic). Every one of the 639 cited declarations exists at the pinned commits (two as anonymous instances at the cited lines, one as a deprecated alias). 60 findings: 1 high, 25 medium, 34 low. The high one: the Multiquadratic summary says the prime-discriminant compositum is proved to be the genus field in both signatures, but for real fields Tau Ceti proves only that it is the narrow genus field (isGenusField_candidateGenusField needs d < 0; the ordinary genus field is candidateGenusFieldReal, its maximal totally real subfield), and target L3-T1 repeats the false wording with fit 'exact'. The medium ones: library material the notes call missing (the finite-place functoriality, single-place and unit-group descriptions of restricted products, the adele extension maps as RestrictedProduct.mapAlongRingHom, the tame different for Dedekind domains, TauCeti.Place in equal characteristic, Module.Finite for completions, global ramification groups via Ideal.inertia), overclaimed fits (finite-place-only tower maps, decomposition and inertia results that assume finite or perfect residue fields, layer 1.4 marked built with two of three formulas missing), wrong carriers and attributions (the discriminant as QuadraticForm.discr, Polynomial.Monic.discr_mul), two errors in the roadmaps themselves (maps of orders do act on NarrowPic; fundamentalCone is not the trivial-modulus case), and duplicates lists that miss owners or record supplier relations.

findings.claim: The note asserts that 'the layer's warning that an arbitrary ring homomorphism induces no map applies to `NarrowPic` but not to `Pic`'. For orders in number fields the warning applies to neither. A ring homomorphism φ : O → O' between orders is injective: a nonzero prime of O contains the nonzero constant term of the minimal polynomial of any of its nonzero elements, an integer that cannot map to 0 in the characteristic-zero ring O'. So φ extends uniquely to a field embedding K → K'. That embedding sends totally positive elements to totally positive elements, because every real embedding of K' composed with it is a real embedding of K; this is Mathlib's `InfinitePlace.IsReal.comap`, which this target cites. Hence an arbitrary ℤ-algebra homomorphism of orders induces maps on both Pic and NarrowPic. The roadmap's statement that such a functoriality statement 'is a false theorem' is false, and the audit endorses half of it.

For d > 0 TauCeti proves only that the compositum is the narrow genus field. The genus field in the all-places sense, which is what IsGenusField and the target's K_gen mean, is for real K the maximal totally real subfield candidateGenusFieldReal. It differs from the compositum whenever a negative prime discriminant divides disc K. Target L3-T1 repeats the roadmap's wording ('K_gen … the compositum of the ℚ(√p*)', with K_gen unramified at all places including the infinite ones, as in T0), and that wording is false for real K.
